name: Hazelnuts
siboNotes: Well tolerated on SIBO diet as they're naturally FODMAP-free and provide beneficial fats without feeding bacterial overgrowth.
preparationTips: Toast lightly to enhance flavor and improve digestibility
Remove skins by roasting then rubbing with a clean towel if desired
Chop or grind just before use to prevent rancidity
Store in airtight container in refrigerator for extended freshness
nutritionalHighlights: High in vitamin E and antioxidants
Good source of magnesium and copper
